description: Java class DomPsiParser that extends XmlParser, used for parsing XML documents into DOM structures by mapping to IntelliJ PSI XML structures, with methods for obtaining node offsets, locations, and managing read locks.

classes.name: DomPsiParser
classes.description: A parser class for converting XML PSI structures into DOM documents, managing read locks, and providing location information for XML nodes.

classes.name: LocationHandle
classes.description: Inner class implementing Location.Handle to resolve node locations with thread safety.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Releases read lock and clears document from context.

methods.name: getNodeStartOffset
methods.description: Returns the start offset of a node within the document.

methods.name: getNodeEndOffset
methods.description: Returns the end offset of a node within the document.

methods.name: parseXml
methods.description: Parses XML from the context, acquiring a read lock, and converting PSI to DOM.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Internal method to convert PSI XML file to DOM, with error handling.

methods.name: getLocation
methods.description: Creates a Location object for a node.

methods.name: getLocation
methods.description: Creates a Location object for a node with delta adjustments.

methods.name: createLocationHandle
methods.description: Creates a handle for deferred location resolution.
